stages = [
    "N5",
    "Z1",
    "Z1/Z2",
    "Z2/Z3",
    "Z3/M1",
    "M1/M2",
    "M2/M3",

    "PL8",
    "PL9",
    "PL10",
    "PL11",
    "PL12"
]

stockings = frappe.get_all(
    "Tank Stocking",
    filters={"docstatus": 1},
    fields=["name", "stocking_datetime", "status"]
)

for s in stockings:

    if not s.stocking_datetime:
        continue

    stocking_time = frappe.utils.get_datetime(s.stocking_datetime)
    current_time = frappe.utils.now_datetime()

    hours_passed = (current_time - stocking_time).total_seconds() / 3600

    stage_index = int(hours_passed // 24)

    if stage_index < len(stages):

        new_stage = stages[stage_index]

        if new_stage != s.status:
            frappe.db.set_value("Tank Stocking", s.name, "status", new_stage)

script:
# =========================================
# RESERVOIR GROUPS
# =========================================

COLLECTION_RESERVOIRS = ["CR1", "CR2"]
CHLORINATION_TARGETS = ["R1", "R2", "R3"]
DECHLORINATION_TARGETS = ["R6", "R7", "R8", "R9"]
OZONATION_TARGETS = ["R4", "R5"]

activity = doc.activity_type


# =========================================================
# 1️⃣ PUMPING
# =========================================================
if activity == "Pumping":

    for row in doc.intake_rows:

        if not row.reservoir:
            frappe.throw(f"Row {row.idx}: Reservoir cannot be empty")

        if row.reservoir not in COLLECTION_RESERVOIRS:
            frappe.throw("Pumping allowed only in CR1, CR2")

        if not row.volume or row.volume <= 0:
            frappe.throw(f"Row {row.idx}: Volume must be greater than 0")

        current_volume = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Reservoir", row.reservoir, "current_volume"
        ) or 0

        frappe.db.set_value("Reservoir", row.reservoir, {
            "current_volume": current_volume + row.volume,
            "water_lot": doc.water_lot,
            "process_status": "Sun Bath State",
            "last_pumping_date": doc.date,
            "last_activity_date": frappe.utils.now()
        })


# =========================================================
# 2️⃣ TREATMENT
# =========================================================
elif activity == "Treatment":

    current_ppm = 0

    for row in doc.chemicals_used:
        if row.ppm:
            current_ppm = row.ppm
            break

    update_data = {
        "current_stage": doc.treatment_type,
        "last_activity_date": frappe.utils.now(),
        "current_ppm": current_ppm
    }

    if doc.treatment_type == "Chlorination":
        update_data.update({
            "chlorination": "Completed",
            "last_chlorination_date": doc.date,
            "chlorination_time": doc.mixing_time
        })

    elif doc.treatment_type == "De-chlorination":
        update_data["dechlorination"] = "Completed"

    elif doc.treatment_type == "Ozonation":
        update_data["ozonation"] = "Completed"

    elif doc.treatment_type == "De-Ozonation":
        update_data["process_status"] = "Ready for Tank"
        update_data["deozonation"] = "Completed"

    elif doc.treatment_type == "EDTA":
        update_data["etda"] = "Completed"

    frappe.db.set_value("Reservoir", doc.reservoir, update_data)


# =========================================================
# 3️⃣ DRAINING
# =========================================================
elif activity == "Draining":

    frappe.db.set_value("Reservoir", doc.reservoir, {
        "current_volume": 0,

script:
if doc.tank:

    tank = frappe.get_doc("Hatchery Tank", doc.tank)

    current_population = tank.current_population or 0

    # Convert units → lakhs
    qty = (doc.custom_gross_quantity or 0) / 100000

    if qty > current_population:
        frappe.throw("Not enough population in selected tank")

    tank.current_population = current_population - qty
    tank.save(ignore_permissions=True)

for row in doc.table_motw:

    if not row.tank:
        continue

    # User has not entered Raise Upto.
    # Do not update this tank.
    if float(row.volume_up or 0) <= 0:
        continue

    tank = frappe.get_doc("Hatchery Tank", row.tank)

    current_volume = float(row.current_volume or 0)

    # Remaining water after drain
    remaining_volume = float(row.volume_down or 0)

    # Final water level
    final_volume = float(row.volume_up or 0)

    # Validation
    if remaining_volume > current_volume:
        remaining_volume = current_volume

    if final_volume < remaining_volume:
        final_volume = remaining_volume

    # Update only when Raise Upto is entered
    tank.current_water_level = final_volume

    # Optional: Update tank salinity also
    if row.required_salinity:
        tank.current_salinity = row.required_salinity

    tank.save(ignore_permissions=True)
